ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A villager finally fixes the creak in their hut that has been there for years.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s hut has a creak. A single beam, near the door, that creaks every time anybody walks in. It has creaked for years. Today (subject) finally gets up on a stool, finds the exact spot, and fixes it with one small wooden wedge. (subject.He/She) climbs down. (subject.He/She) walks in. Silence.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: (subject) brings (friend) round to hear it. "Listen." (friend) walks in. Nothing. "...What am I listening to?" "The creak! It's GONE!" (friend) is polite about it. (subject) walks in and out of the door eleven more times that afternoon, just to enjoy the quiet.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: (subject) walks in and out of the doorway a few times, beaming. Nobody else will ever notice. That's alright. That night, lying in bed, (subject) realizes (subject.he/she) half misses the creak. (subject.He/She) decides not to tell anybody that.
